draft.summary: Allow cancellation before preparation with a full automatic refund
draft.description:
## Context
Type: Story (created as Task; this Jira project has no Story type).

Customers currently call Operations to cancel orders, and refunds are issued manually about ten times a week. Finance agreed to allow eligible cancellations from the app, with preparation starting at "In the oven".

## User Story
As a customer, I want to cancel my order from the app before preparation starts and receive a full refund to the same card, so that I do not have to call Operations for an eligible cancellation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Eligible cancellation and full refund** (Happy path) — A customer cancels an order from the app before its status reaches "In the oven". Expected: the order is cancelled and a full refund is issued automatically to the same card.
- AC2: **Preparation has started** (Negative case) — An order has reached "In the oven" or a later status. Expected: the cancel option is not shown and the order cannot be cancelled from the app.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
After "In the oven", customers call Operations; no support number or UI message was specified. Dependency: refund entries belong to existing daily cash close work (00:07:30–00:07:45); no ticket key was provided. Gift cards are out of scope. The 50% partial-refund proposal was withdrawn. Open question (Andrés Gil): provider settlement time in days. Cancellation controls, confirmation text and failure handling were not specified.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met.
- [ ] Developer testing and sanity check completed.
- [ ] Peer review approved.
- [ ] QA validation approved.
- [ ] Demo completed.
- [ ] Documentation updated, if applicable.
- [ ] Release status and evidence recorded.

## Completion Evidence
Pending — to be linked as it becomes available.
draft.validation: AC1–AC2 are specific, observable and traceable to 00:01:10–00:02:36 and 00:03:50–00:04:12. They cover the agreed in-app cancellation, full automatic refund to the same card and cancellation restriction. No edge case, provider timing, failure handling or partial refund rule was invented; the source supports happy-path and negative cases only.
